note: Offline/demo catalog for Kitsu Live. These are original placeholder titles written for this project, not real releases. Posters render as generated gradients. When the live API is reachable, none of this is used.

anime.title: Lantern of the Drowned Sky
anime.synopsis: Thirty years after the ocean rose into the clouds, lamp-keepers climb the drowned towers to keep the last beacons lit. Ciel takes her father's route on the night the lights begin answering back.

anime.title: Salt & Signal
anime.synopsis: A radio operator on a decommissioned coastal station keeps receiving weather reports for a town that was never built. She starts forecasting for it anyway.

anime.title: The Cartographer Eats Last
anime.synopsis: Mapmaking is a hungry trade when the roads rearrange themselves nightly. Orin surveys a kingdom that resents being measured, armed with ink, nerve, and a mule who has opinions.

anime.title: Velvet Static
anime.synopsis: A late-night variety show films in a studio where the audience applause arrives four seconds early. The host decides to find out who is clapping.

anime.title: Grandmother Machine
anime.synopsis: A repair shop inherits a loom that remembers every hand that worked it. Three generations argue about whether remembering counts as being alive.

anime.title: Pavement Gods
anime.synopsis: Street basketball in a district where the courts are older than the city charter, and losing means you sweep. Nobody sweeps willingly.

anime.title: Nine Hundred Winters
anime.synopsis: The border wall is maintained by soldiers who age one year per century. Nine hundred winters in, the youngest of them finally asks what is on the other side.

anime.title: Spring Onion Detective Agency
anime.synopsis: Two retired cooks solve neighbourhood crimes in the order the ingredients spoil. The method is unorthodox. The clearance rate is not.

anime.title: Hymn for Tired Machines
anime.synopsis: Decommissioned walkers are sung to sleep by technicians trained in a dead liturgy. One refuses the hymn, and the choir has to decide what that means.

anime.title: Paper Tiger, Paper Town
anime.synopsis: A town rebuilt entirely from folded paper after the fire holds up fine until it rains. Everyone has agreed not to mention the forecast.

anime.title: Combat Etiquette
anime.synopsis: Duelling is legal, lethal, and governed by 400 pages of protocol. Hana wins every fight and loses every hearing.

anime.title: The Long Quiet Orbit
anime.synopsis: Two station keepers trade eleven-month letters across an orbit that lets them meet for six days a decade. This is the fourth meeting, and the first argument.

anime.title: Knifework in Minor Key
anime.synopsis: A concert hall's orchestra doubles as its security detail. The new second violin cannot read music and has never missed.

anime.title: Appetite for Small Gods
anime.synopsis: Household deities are shrinking because nobody cooks anymore. A failing restaurant becomes the last temple with a working kitchen.

anime.title: Rust Garden
anime.synopsis: Everything left in the yard for more than a season starts to flower. The new tenant is told not to sit still too long.

anime.title: Second Daughter Protocol
anime.synopsis: A dynasty keeps a spare heir asleep in case the first one fails. She wakes early, by accident, and reads her own contingency file.

anime.title: Tidepool Giants
anime.synopsis: At low tide the rock pools hold things the size of houses, politely folded. A child spends one summer learning the etiquette of unfolding them.

anime.title: Debt of the Rain Season
anime.synopsis: A courier collects favours instead of money and the ledger has outlived four owners. The rains are early, and so is the balance.

anime.title: Afterschool Demolition Club
anime.synopsis: The club takes down condemned buildings for the municipal fee and the catharsis. Membership is three students and a crane they are not licensed for.

anime.title: Coldwater Canon
anime.synopsis: A winter swim team trains to a metronome nobody else can hear. Their coach is writing the piece they are racing inside of.
